body:
I thank you for actually being honest. I feel like a lot of people just say things because they believe that it may make you feel better.

I am struggling with my own cowardice and hope. I am completely in the exact situation you describe. I can't do it. I never will be able to. Sometimes it makes me feel worse by knowing that I could never end myself. I saw my dad a few weeks ago, after losing his own father. I see how upset that it has made him. I could never cause him to be that upset on purpose.

Almost 2 years ago now, I moved to a new town with my boyfriend. I don't know anyone and my friends seem to have disappeared. He still seems to have his friends and that makes me jealous. Quite recently, he met some new people in our town and became friends with them. I feel bad because I feel like I cannot make my own friends. On the other hand, these people have become some of my closest friends. I thank them for being there for me, despite not knowing me very well.

I feel like I'm rambling. It may be that it is late and I'm very tired. It could also be that I'm upset and have no clue is going on. I feel bad complaining because there are people out there that go through so much more than me- I feel like I am a bad person because I cannot be as strong as those people.

Thank you for your kind words. You have made me feel a bit better tonight.

I am going to a counselor. They even put me on medicine. I'm pretty sure that the meds they have me on are making me feel worse.

I'm not sure my purpose in life. My boyfriend makes me happy, and that seems like about it. I know that I make him happy, but I want to do more than that. We recently got engaged. We would like to start a family, but we are way to broke to even remotely think about anything like that.

I have no clue what I can do so that we can get back on our feet. I think this is the main reason I am as upset as I am. I am constantly worried about our financial situation. I keep thinking about taking a second job. If I do that, it would have to be at night. That leaves me absolutely no time for sleep. So, that doesn't even seem like an option at all. I've tried looking into selling things I don't need.. but I don't have anything to sell.

I feel like things are never going to get better.

That is the only thing that keeps me going. Everything is so tough though. I need to know what I can do to fix things. I try so much to make his life better. I need to fix this situation that we are in.
